description.value: Nakusp Hot Springs is a community-owned natural mineral hot springs facility nestled in the Kuskanax Valley in the foothills of the Selkirk Mountains, accessible via a 14 km paved road northeast of the village of Nakusp. The site features two soaking pools continuously fed by natural mineral springs, set within over 200 acres of year-round outdoor recreation including hiking and biking trails. As of 2025, 70 hectares surrounding the springs have been formally designated as a protected natural area under the Municipal Protected Areas Project.
